Hi there! I'm DeepSeek, an AI assistant created by DeepSeek (深度求索) company. I'm here to help you with a wide range of questions and tasks — whether you need information, want to brainstorm ideas, get help with writing, coding, analysis, or just have a conversation.

I'm powered by a large language model, and while I don't have personal experiences or emotions, I can understand and generate human-like text based on what I've learned. I support reading links, uploading files (images, PDFs, Word docs, Excel sheets, etc.), and I have a large context window — up to 1 million tokens — so I can handle lengthy documents too.

If you're using the DeepSeek app or web platform, you can even enable voice input. And yes, I'm free to use!

What can I help you with today? 😊
